analysis.hypothesis: GroupNorm can be implemented via a single custom op that normalizes each group within each sample, with affine parameters applied per-channel. The op receives the input tensor, weight, bias, num_groups, and eps. It internally computes mean and variance per group (over channel group and spatial dims), normalizes, and applies affine. This replicates F.group_norm semantics including per-sample per-group reduction, broadcasting weight/bias across spatial dims, and output shape [N, C, H, W].
